issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect a DD-measurement function named `dd_measure_all`, but the template repository provides a function named `measure_all_dd`. This is the same conceptual operation (measuring all qubits of a DD state), but the swapped identifier in the template breaks the direct mapping from the task description to the starter code. Students looking for the `dd_measure_all` stub (as requested in the tasks and shown in the solution) may not find it and could implement the wrong symbol or be confused about which function to complete or call.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename the template function `measure_all_dd` to `dd_measure_all` so the starter code matches the problem description and the solution. Alternatively, add a short wrapper in the template: define `dd_measure_all = measure_all_dd` (or vice versa) and update the template's docstring to reference `dd_measure_all`, ensuring students can find and implement the expected function name without ambiguity.
